platform_final.failure_reason: Runner exited with test failures or runtime errors

failed_tests.requirement: REQ-9.1: Quick Navigation from Recently Updated

confirmed_facts: The platform final run used main.py and /workspace/tests; bundled-test fallback hits were zero and no plaintext API key was recorded.
Frontend build, backend startup, and application reachability on http://127.0.0.1:3000 completed before the final suite.
The final Playwright suite used one worker, ran 34 tests in about 49.9 seconds, and failed exactly REQ-2.2, REQ-6.3.1, and REQ-9.1.
REQ-2.2 navigated to / but did not expose a visible BookStack User locator before the 10-second deadline.
REQ-6.3.1 did not expose a visible Page 6.3.1 locator; the final error context contains no response body, URL, or DOM snapshot.
REQ-9.1 did not expose a visible Page Updated 9.1 locator after the create, return-home, and recently-updated navigation flow; the final error context contains no response body or DOM snapshot.
Internal targeted acceptance failed REQ-2.2, REQ-6.3.1, and REQ-9.1 in round 0, round 1, and round 2. Full-suite logs report 31/34, then 32/34 with REQ-6.3.1 and REQ-9.1 failing, then 31/34 again.

The logs record two full-suite repair turns with wrote=True but verified=False; the second guard states that the preceding turn claimed completion without running build, start, or request verification.

The final template source contains an authenticated header renderer, the page-reading route before the generic book route, server-side page title replacement, recently-updated rendering, and the page-create mutation path.

The final template database contains Book 6.3.1 with page 101, Page 6.3.1, Book 9.1, Page Updated 9.1, and a recentlyUpdatedPages entry; it also contains mutations from earlier acceptance flows, proving that the packaged database was not a clean seed at the time of artifact capture.

The design snapshot describes the REQ-2.2 nickname as generic text, while the public helper first probes a heading and the final error reports that heading locator as the unresolved locator; the final served DOM is unavailable, so the runtime mechanism cannot be fully proven.
The run used 1219 provider requests, 31777631 platform tokens, 31777518 provider-total tokens, cost 17.108443 CNY, and run_duration_seconds 10948.

failure_chains.chain: The official flow logs in with the seeded user, navigates to /, and checks for BookStack User. The final run reached / but the expected visible locator never appeared.
failure_chains.direct_evidence: The final Playwright report records the missing heading locator. In the final template source, authedHeader emits the nickname in a span.user-chip rather than a heading, while the design snapshot describes generic text. This is a strong candidate for an authenticated-header DOM/role mismatch, but no final DOM or cookie trace is available.

failure_chains.chain: The official flow opens Book 6.3.1, clicks the linked Page 6.3.1, and checks the reading page heading. The final package contains the expected page/book mapping, route, and PAGE_TITLE replacement, yet the final browser did not expose the heading.
failure_chains.direct_evidence: The final report records only a missing locator; static source and database evidence establish nominal implementation, not the actual final response body or DOM.

failure_chains.chain: The official flow creates Page Updated 9.1 anonymously, returns home, clicks the Recently Updated Pages link, and checks the reading page heading. The final source has the create mutation, global recent-list persistence, anonymous homepage section, and page-reading route, but the locator was still absent.
failure_chains.direct_evidence: The final report records a missing Page Updated 9.1 locator. Logs mention avoiding shared cross-session counters, and the final database contains prior REQ-9.1 mutations; no request trace or clean-state comparison proves whether the failure came from state carryover, the generated package, or runtime readback.

failure_chains.chain: Targeted and full-suite acceptance did not converge before packaging. The agent performed repair turns without verified build/start/request checks, then the platform rebuilt and ran the final suite from the generated package.
failure_chains.direct_evidence: Logs show full-suite round changes, wrote=True/verified=False repair records, a fresh platform build/start sequence, and final failures. No source/dist/database hash set or platform build binding is available.

root_cause_candidates.candidate: Authenticated nickname is not exposed in the final served DOM in the role/name form that the official assertion can observe, or the authenticated render is not active for the failing request.
root_cause_candidates.evidence: REQ-2.2 fails only at the nickname assertion after navigation to /; the source renderer emits a span.user-chip and the final DOM is unavailable.

root_cause_candidates.candidate: Mutable database/session state from internal acceptance was carried into the final package or evaluation, making clean and final execution non-equivalent.
root_cause_candidates.evidence: The final db.json contains prior-created pages, books, favorites, recently-viewed entries, and recently-updated entries; logs explicitly mention avoiding shared cross-session counters; no clean pre-platform database reset or checksum exists.

root_cause_candidates.candidate: The internal acceptance package and final platform package/build output were not semantically identical despite sharing a submission lineage.
root_cause_candidates.evidence: The platform has no agent_build_id, code_sha, or ZIP-to-build binding; repair logs report writes without verification; the platform rebuilt frontend artifacts after agent execution.
root_cause_candidates.scope: frontend build, generated dist, packaging, and runner lifecycle

root_cause_candidates.candidate: The page-reading/recently-updated server-side readback path returns a response that does not contain the newly expected page text under the final runtime state.
root_cause_candidates.evidence: Both failures are missing-text assertions; nominal routes and data exist, but no final response body, request status, or DOM is available.
root_cause_candidates.scope: backend/server.js, frontend/src/books-page-view.html, frontend/src/index.html, and database state

root_cause_candidates.candidate: The 10-second timeout alone is the primary cause.
root_cause_candidates.evidence: All three errors report element(s) not found rather than a locator appearing immediately after the deadline; the app completed 31 other tests.

excluded_causes: Not a wrong entrypoint: main.py was executed.
Not a wrong test directory: /workspace/tests was used.
Not a plaintext API key leak.
Not a complete application outage: 31 of 34 public tests passed and the app was reachable.
Not absence of the nominal source routes/templates/data fixtures for the three failed requirements; runtime response correctness remains unproven.
Not an OOM or runner-wide termination; the final report completed and was parsed.
evidence_gaps: No final Playwright trace, screenshot, DOM snapshot, response body, or network HAR for any of the three failures.
No request-level evidence for POST /api/login, GET / after login, the REQ-6.3.1 page link/reading request, or the REQ-9.1 create/home/reading sequence.
No browser cookie/session trace proving whether the failing REQ-2.2 GET / request carried the login session.
No clean database checksum immediately before the platform final suite; final db.json contains prior acceptance mutations.
No source, frontend/dist, database, or package manifest hash set proving internal acceptance and final platform artifacts were byte-identical.
No task_snapshot_id, agent_build_id, code_sha, or platform-provided ZIP-to-build binding.
minimal_reproduction_experiments: From a pristine copy, run only REQ-2.2 and capture POST /api/login status/Set-Cookie, the subsequent GET / response body, accessible roles, and the nickname locator candidates.
From a pristine copy, run only REQ-6.3.1 and capture the Book 6.3.1 details response, clicked page href, GET /books/11/pages/101 status/body, and rendered heading.
From a pristine copy, run only REQ-9.1 and capture POST page-create status/location, GET /books/15, GET / homepage HTML, recent-link href, and the final reading-page response/DOM.
Repeat the three targeted flows once after a clean reset and once after the internal full suite without reset; compare db.json hashes, session state, response bodies, and DOMs.
Before any next submission, build frontend/dist from frontend/src, record source/dist/database hashes, verify the three exact official specs, and package from a deterministic clean seed.

stage5_recommendation.acceptance: Recommend Stage5 receive this diagnosis conditionally; do not treat it as proof of a code-only defect or platform success.
priority: P0: reproduce the three failed flows on a pristine package with response and DOM capture.

P0: add local gates for login cookie/GET-home nickname, page-reading GET response/heading, and recently-updated create-to-reading readback.
P1: if clean reproduction confirms defects, make the smallest targeted changes to authenticated rendering and page/recently-updated readback; do not rewrite the application.
P1: record source/dist/database/package hashes and a final targeted Playwright report before spending on a full platform run.
Do not modify official tests or helpers.
change_boundary: backend/data/db.json or deterministic packaging reset logic
do_not_do: No global Playwright timeout increase as the first fix.
No full platform rerun before the three targeted clean-state reproductions converge.
Do not merge this Run's diagnosis into 5669f7d1777c or 00c59e0762fb conclusions.

impact_estimate.completion_rate: 31/34 = 91.2%; resolving all three flows would target 34/34 = 100%, a theoretical gain of 8.8 percentage points subject to clean-state verification.
impact_estimate.token: This Run consumed 31777631 platform tokens across 1219 requests at 17.108443 CNY; targeted local reproduction is materially safer than another full generation loop.
impact_estimate.runtime: The final Playwright suite took about 49.9 seconds, including roughly 30 seconds across three 10-second timeouts; the total Run duration was 10948 seconds and was dominated by generation/repair.
impact_estimate.risk: The largest residual risk is the unverified acceptance-to-package-to-platform boundary combined with mutable database/session state. A code-only change without clean reproduction could regress 31 passing scenarios.
